notes.title: Updated demo and challenge credit reset
notes.content:
[h1]🗨  Dear Players! You asked and we delivered.[/h1]
📬 By popular demand, we have adjusted easier levels in all CHALLENGE to allow novice players the chance to play and move with 'just a little less intensity'!

🤹 To ensure all players can benefit from the new changes we have also reset challenge credits and added new Demo Challenge Leaderboard for your fighting pleasure.

❤ Your VIRO MOVE Team ❤
Download ➡ tinyurl.com/SteamViro

____________________________
Also check our slideshow with leaderboards!
Congrats to our Demo Launch Champions:
🥇 PeskyCashew | 🥈 Nashlax | 🥉 Tomas
